outcome: prefill completed and 4229 tokens were generated, then mtplx refused to grow the paged KV cache
error_detail: insufficient memory to grow the paged KV cache: growing 16 caches from 168192 to 252288 rows ... needs 15.72 GiB
explanation: With a 262K window the KV cache grows in large steps toward the window. On 64 GB the last step does not fit. Use a window close to what you need (e.g. 163840) so the final growth step stays small.

dense_decode_ceiling_tokens.why: Above the ceiling mtplx repages decode KV and the packed fast verify lane is excluded (developers measured 16-18 -> 12 tok/s at ~147K). Ceiling = RAM * percent / 65536 bytes per token (27B: 16 full-attention layers x K+V x 4 KV heads x 256 dims x bf16).
